Why do warm-blooded beauties suddenly turn to stone?!

33991: Confronted by Apartheid and a father who was Minister of Censorship, Ingrid Jonker searched for a home, searched for love. 34247: When Chotu`s surprise party for his don father ends in tragedy, he inherits the criminal empire and uncovers his uncle Murthy`s deceit. Meanwhile, Kittu, a struggling cab driver pretending to be deaf, becomes entangled in danger after unknowingly helping twin murderers.

I'm yours to have and to hold till DEATH do us part.
34759: While dealing with a burnt-down house, smelly diapers and brutal lack of sleep, a Lower Bavarian police officer faces his worst adversary: cholesterol.
35015: Released from prison under a New Year amnesty, a criminal tries to pick up the threads of a life changed not only by his daring plan to rob a jewelry store in out-of-season Cannes, but also by a very special someone he met there.
35527: An attorney uncovers a political conspiracy in the brutal killing of a wealthy young woman.
In a world of lies, nothing is more dangerous than the Truth.

Between heaven and earth, where love became a legend.

36551: A professional poker player falls deep into underworld when he takes an unexpected wager from a mysterious high roller.
36807: On honeymoon on the island of Lesbos, a woman falls for the daughter of a Russian archaeologist.
37063: Olavi, an aged and shabby art dealer, is planning to retire. Accidentally he finds an old painting that he suspects being much more valuable than his colleagues have priced it. 37319: Natsume Mochizuki  works as a teen model in Tokyo, but she learns that she has to move to her father's hometown of Ukigumo. 37575: Madeinusa is a girl who lives in an isolated village in the mountains of Peru. This strange place is characterized by its religious fervor, and seemingly odd custom: from Good Friday at three o’clock in the afternoon to Easter Sunday, the whole village can do whatever it feels like.
37831: A mother and her teen daughter from a middle-class background, whose humble life goes upside down, when the daughter gets possessed by a ghost and her single mother seeks the help of their cowardly neighbour.

The street where starlets are made!
38343: In 1930s Budapest, naïve orphan Luisa Ginglebuscher becomes an usherette at the local movie house, determined to succeed in her first job by doing good deeds for others and maintaining her purity. A game of fascination and seduction
38855: Aman Khanna, a once successful singer, is drowning his life into alcohol, despair and self- destruction after his 6 years old son died in a freak accident. 39111: A woman sexually assaulted by her new boss's brother-in-law tries to move on as if nothing happened, but the night weighs heavily on her mind and body.
39367: A shy, stuttering professor brings satanist Aleister Crowley back to life.
In three days, his resurrection will be complete…
39623: A married college professor decides to seduce her student, whom she hired as a handyman for her yacht. The hesitant student succumbs to his buxom professor, but their romance is interrupted by her corrupt husband and a masked murderer.
From his French maid, he got Private Lessons. Now his English professor is giving him a REAL education.

40391: A man with financial troubles finds himself on a boozy road trip with a wealthy stranger.
40647: Officer Blanca Bravo arrives in Juarez, Mexico — a grim nexus of corporate colonialism and sexual tourism — to investigate a rash of killings targeting female migrant workers. 40903: A good-looking but naive lad leaves his mountain village to try and make his way in Paris. He thinks maybe he will try acting but things don't go too well for him. I'll do almost anything for money. ...but I don't kiss.

She has a lust for life - pray it's not yours!
41415: An English nanny and one of two brothers fall down a Hawaiian cave, all the way to Atlantis.

41927: A story of three couples and their intertwining love stories set in 1940s Taiwan and Shanghai, centered around the 1949 sinking of Taiping.
42183: A young Buenos Aires mother finds employment as a sex worker and struggles to live under the same laws that are supposed to protect her.
42695: Five people embark on a motorhome road trip through Europe to fulfill an elderly man's last wish. "Day by Day" is a life-affirming comedy with a lot of humor and some seriousness. Friendships develop, love arises and life-changing decisions are made, a story that it is never too late to rethink in life.
43207: A U.S. Marshal seeking justice for his brother's murder defends a small town from a corrupt Mayor and his henchmen with intents to revive the civil war.

43975: In a small border town, a sheriff and his 'associate', involved in an operation in which they divert marijuana through the border, must kill another smuggler who has gone into business for himself.

44487: A Jewish family, new to the neighborhood, are recording their youngest son's birthday celebrations on video when their home is suddenly invaded by a band of meth-head Neo-Nazis.
44999: A silent documentary which follows a branch of the Bakhtiari tribe of Persia as they and their herds make their epic seasonal journey to better pastures.
Self - Chief of the Bakhtyari Tribe

The terror of Wall Street was a chump for this girl!
46023: In this quirky horror comedy, five hikers explore a mountain, casually heeding superstitious warnings - but later realize that one of them is a ghost.

Alerted by her childhood friends, Marie Darling, Claire’s estranged daughter, is forced to come back to the family mansion to stop this sale and unveil the reasons behind her mother’s eccentric decision.
47047: Using home videos from fans from across the globe and never-before-seen drone footage obtained during the victory parade in Buenos Aires, on streets dyed white and sky blue. THE PEOPLE'S CUP. THE PEOPLE'S MOVIE.
47303: An account of the rise and fall of a silent film comic, Billy Bright. A funny new motion picture that tells Hollywood like it was!
47559: In danger of losing his badge, a big city detective agrees to aid a small town sheriff in a routine missing persons investigation only to discover that at least one girl has gone missing in this sleepy fishing town each year for the last twenty years. 47815: News about the disappearance of panties is still being covered every day. Kyosuke still wears Aiko Completo's panties to battle evil. After a local shootout, Anton ends up in the police station, from where he is released at the intervention of Moscow’s crime lords. In exchange, the latter asks Anton for a small, but dangerous service
48327: Former boss Wei Pingan makes his living by selling cemeteries. 50119: The bad romance between Luisa Ferida and Osvaldo Valenti, two of the foremost movie stars in Fascist Italy, who were supporters of the regime to the bitter end, and shared its brutal downfall.

The Beginning of Life invites everyone to reflect: are we taking good care of this unique moment, which defines both the present and future of humankind?
If we change the beginning of the story, we change the whole story.

Sometimes you win. Sometimes you learn.

51655: Fairytale about heroic Vasya and beautiful Alenushka.
